tldr: 台積電10/15法說會為本週重頭戲，外資對2奈米毛利與AI需求看法分歧。
記憶體續處上行循環，TrendForce估Q4 DRAM、NAND合約價受AI伺服器需求推升續漲。
監理與收益商品牽動資金，金管會推2026證券與資安新制、高股息ETF版圖洗牌。
美9月CPI今日公布，為Fed 10月底會議前關鍵數據，前次Fed已升息。
美股小幅收低、大型銀行揭開財報季，油價守穩百元之上。

items.title_zh: 台積電10/15法說登場 外資多空分歧
items.title_en: TSMC's Oct 15 earnings call looms as foreign brokers split on margins vs AI demand
items.summary_zh: 權值最重的台積電將於10月15日公布第三季財報，券商看法分歧。偏空者憂心2奈米製程爬坡與海外設廠恐壓縮毛利率，偏多者則認為AI加速器需求強勁、支撐長線成長與資本支出。市場聚焦2奈米進度、先進封裝產能與2027年投資展望，法說結果將牽動占大盤逾四成權重的台積電股價，並主導加權指數短線多空方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's most heavily weighted stock reports third-quarter results on Oct 15, and sell-side views are divided. Bears warn the 2nm ramp and overseas fab build-outs could compress gross margin, while bulls argue surging AI-accelerator demand underpins long-run growth and capex. Guidance on 2nm progress, advanced-packaging capacity and 2027 spending will steer the weighting-heavy index.

items.title_zh: AI需求續強 台積電Q4淨利拚新高 法說成焦點
items.title_en: AI demand seen lifting TSMC's Q4 profit toward a record, keeping the call in focus
items.summary_zh: 分析師預期AI相關需求維持強勁，將推升台積電第四季淨利挑戰新高，使週三法說會成為盤面最大焦點。高效能運算與先進製程的動能，可望抵銷其他應用的淡季疲弱。投資人關注公司是否再上修全年營收成長預估，以及對2027年產能與資本支出的說明，以評估台灣AI主導獲利循環的續航力，牽動電子權值股與大盤表現。
items.summary_en: Analysts expect resilient AI-related demand to push TSMC's fourth-quarter net profit toward a fresh high, making Wednesday's results the market's key event. Continued strength in high-performance computing and advanced nodes is seen offsetting seasonal softness elsewhere, while investors look for an updated full-year revenue-growth outlook and 2027 capacity commentary to gauge the durability of Taiwan's AI-led earnings cycle.

items.title_zh: 研調估Q4記憶體合約價續漲 AI伺服器撐盤
items.title_en: TrendForce sees memory contract prices still climbing in Q4 on AI-server demand
items.summary_zh: TrendForce預估第四季標準型DRAM合約價季增約10~15%，計入HBM後整體上漲15~20%，NAND Flash則季增15~20%，AI伺服器與資料中心需求使市況維持極度緊缺。供應商持續將先進製程產能優先配置給伺服器產品，市場供不應求，惟漲幅可望較前幾季趨緩。報價續強撐起台廠記憶體與模組業者營收與毛利，但擴產節奏與消費端需求仍是後續觀察重點。
items.summary_en: TrendForce projects fourth-quarter conventional DRAM contract prices rising about 10–15% sequentially—and 15–20% including HBM—while NAND Flash gains 15–20%, as AI-server and data-center demand keeps supply extremely tight. Makers keep prioritizing advanced-process capacity for server products, leaving the market undersupplied, though the pace of increases is expected to moderate from earlier quarters.

items.title_zh: 記憶體供給緊俏延續至2027 PC廠加大備貨
items.title_en: PC makers stockpile as memory supply seen staying tight into 2027
items.summary_zh: 研調指出，筆電品牌雖承擔較高零組件成本，仍積極拉貨，預期DRAM供給緊張將延續至2027年，因產能持續移往伺服器，明年PC用DRAM供給甚至可能萎縮。伺服器DRAM供需失衡估延續至第四季，部分報價受長約價格區間機制約束。整體顯示記憶體產業處於跨季度上行循環，台廠相關供應鏈營運動能可望延續，惟須留意消費性終端需求與價格漲勢收斂情況。
items.summary_en: Notebook brands are carrying higher component costs yet keep buying aggressively, expecting DRAM supply to remain tight into 2027 as capacity shifts toward servers; PC DRAM supply could even contract next year. The server DRAM supply-demand imbalance is likely to persist through the fourth quarter, with some pricing capped by long-term-agreement mechanisms, reinforcing a multi-quarter up-cycle for the sector.

items.title_zh: 金管會推2026證券市場多項新制
items.title_en: FSC rolls out a package of 2026 securities-market reforms
items.summary_zh: 金管會自2026年起分階段實施多項資本市場新制，包括上市櫃公司提前上傳股東會議事手冊及年報、庫藏股買回申報自5月1日起改採電子化，以及集保公司3月31日起建置電子化紀念品（eGift）平台，讓股東線上領取股東會紀念品。相關措施旨在強化資訊揭露、提升作業效率與投資人便利性，並推動股東會數位化，為證券市場制度面帶來一波調整，業者須配合調整申報與作業流程。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission is phasing in multiple capital-market measures through 2026, including earlier uploading of shareholder-meeting handbooks and annual reports, a shift to electronic filing for treasury-share buybacks from May 1, and a central-depository "eGift" platform (from March 31) letting shareholders claim meeting souvenirs online. The steps aim to improve disclosure, efficiency and investor convenience.

items.title_zh: 金管會強化2026金融資安監理
items.title_en: FSC tightens financial-sector cybersecurity supervision for 2026
items.summary_zh: 金管會2026年新增金融機構資安監理要求，明定資安長權責、將零信任架構列為必備，並要求建立軟體供應鏈安全機制。此舉回應數位金融與第三方風險升高的趨勢，要求銀行、保險與證券業者強化治理與韌性。隨著金融服務持續線上化，資安監理標準提高將牽動業者的系統投資與組織調整，也凸顯主管機關對營運持續與客戶資料保護的重視，為金融業重要的法遵與風控課題。
items.summary_en: The regulator is adding cybersecurity requirements for financial institutions in 2026, clarifying the chief information security officer's duties, making a zero-trust architecture a baseline expectation, and requiring software-supply-chain security mechanisms. The push responds to rising digital-finance and third-party risks, pressing banks, insurers and securities firms to upgrade governance and resilience as services move further online.

items.title_zh: 國泰00878調高配息 受益人逾173萬
items.title_en: Cathay 00878 lifts payout as its investor base tops 1.7 million
items.summary_zh: 台灣人氣最高的高股息ETF之一國泰永續高股息（00878）將最新一季配息調高至每單位0.42元，推估年化配息率約7.48%，受益人數突破173萬。配息調升凸顯散戶對收益型商品需求穩定。不過年化配息率係依單季配息推估，實際報酬仍取決於成分股評價與除息後的填息狀況，投資人布局時仍須留意股價波動與整體台股位階，避免僅以配息率作為唯一依據。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend (00878), one of Taiwan's most popular income ETFs, raised its latest quarterly distribution to NT$0.42 per unit, implying an annualized yield around 7.48%, with its beneficiary count exceeding 1.7 million. The higher payout underscores steady retail demand for dividend products, though actual returns still hinge on constituent valuations and price recovery after ex-dividend.

items.title_zh: 高股息ETF洗牌 市值型0050含息報酬領先
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs reshuffle as market-cap 0050 outperforms on total return
items.summary_zh: 台灣ETF版圖出現變化：2026年以來市值型元大台灣50（0050）含息報酬領先，部分高股息ETF相對落後，資金流向也出現分化，元大高股息（0056）受益人增加、00878則略見流失，促使存股族在成長型與收益型間重新配置。理財顧問並提醒，配息金額偏高可能推升個人綜所稅級距，高資產族群布局高股息商品時，宜一併納入稅務與資產配置規劃，而非只看配息率高低。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's ETF landscape is shifting: market-cap Yuanta Taiwan Top 50 (0050) has led on total (dividend-inclusive) return in 2026, while some high-dividend products lagged. Investor flows have diverged—Yuanta High Dividend (0056) added holders while 00878 saw some attrition—prompting savers to rebalance between growth and income. Advisers note heavy dividend payouts can also push investors into higher tax brackets, warranting planning.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅修法 死亡前贈與稅負改由受贈人負擔
items.title_en: Estate-and-gift-tax amendment shifts the tax burden to gift recipients
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過遺產及贈與稅法修正、總統9月11日公布，以回應憲法法庭判決。被繼承人死亡前兩年內贈與特定親屬的財產仍併入遺產總額，但稅負改由各受贈人按比例負擔，不再由其他繼承人分攤；同時取消稅額滿30萬元才能申請分期的門檻，並調整滯納金計算。新制影響高資產族群的傳承與贈與規劃，建議及早檢視財產移轉與保單、信託安排，以降低稅務風險並兼顧家族傳承的彈性。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's legislature passed amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act, promulgated on Sept 11, responding to a Constitutional Court ruling. Property gifted to specified relatives within two years before death is still added to the estate, but the tax is now borne proportionally by each recipient rather than shared among other heirs. The change also removes the NT$300,000 threshold for applying to pay in installments and recalculates late-payment surcharges.

items.title_zh: 2026綜所稅減稅 長照與基本生活費扣除額調高
items.title_en: 2026 income-tax relief raises long-term-care and basic-living deductions
items.summary_zh: 2026年綜所稅申報，長照特別扣除額提高至18萬元，每人基本生活費調升至21.3萬元，減輕有長照需求家庭的稅負。國稅局並提醒，網紅等個人若自平台取得分潤，須列入執行業務收入（表演人）依規定申報，顯示稅局在推出減稅的同時，也加強對數位經濟所得查核。民眾宜留意新制申報細節與憑證保存，避免漏報受罰，並善用各項扣除額合法節稅。
items.summary_en: For the 2026 filing season, Taiwan raised the special long-term-care deduction to NT$180,000 and lifted the per-person basic living expense to NT$213,000, easing the burden on households with care needs. Authorities also reminded that online influencers receiving platform revenue-sharing must report it as professional (performer) practice income, as tax offices tighten oversight of digital-economy earnings.

items.title_zh: 美9月CPI今日登場 為Fed決策前最後關鍵數據
items.title_en: US September CPI due today is the last big data point before the Fed
items.summary_zh: 美國9月消費者物價指數於10月14日（週三）公布，距Fed 10月27至28日會議約兩週。市場預估整體CPI年增約3.6~3.7%、核心約2.4~2.5%，能源被視為推升整體數字主因。繼Fed 9月升息後，市場正評估是否再度升息，其中核心CPI最可能左右利率押注。數據若高於預期恐升高升息疑慮，牽動美債殖利率與全球風險性資產，台灣以出口為導向，須密切關注外需與匯率連動。
items.summary_en: The September consumer price index is released Wednesday, Oct 14, about two weeks before the FOMC's Oct 27–28 meeting. Street forecasts put headline inflation near 3.6–3.7% and core around 2.4–2.5% year-on-year, with energy seen driving the headline rise. After the Fed's September rate hike, markets are weighing whether another move is imminent, making core CPI the figure most likely to shift the odds.

items.title_zh: Fed九月升息後 利率路徑至十月底仍不明朗
items.title_en: Fed's September hike leaves the rate path uncertain into late October
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會9月將目標利率區間上調1碼，為近年首次升息，點陣圖並暗示年底前可能再升一次。期貨市場看法分歧，對10月升息機率僅給約4至5成，部分分析師預期Fed可能等到12月才行動。油價走高與通膨僵固，使政策高度依賴數據。市場聚焦CPI與就業數據變化，利率走向牽動美債殖利率、美元與全球股市，也影響台灣資金流向與外資動向。
items.summary_en: The Federal Reserve raised its target range by 25 basis points in September—its first hike in years—and the dot plot signals the possibility of one more move by year-end. Futures markets are split, pricing only about a 40–50% chance of an October increase, with some analysts expecting the Fed to wait until December. Rising oil prices and sticky inflation keep policy highly data-dependent.

items.title_zh: 美股創高遇油價破百與美債殖利率急升雙壓
items.title_en: Wall Street's record run meets higher oil and surging Treasury yields
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經分析指出，美股在標普500與那斯達克屢創新高後，開始面臨長天期美債殖利率急升與油價重返每桶100美元的雙重壓力；10年期美債殖利率一度升至約5.36%，30年期更突破5.7%。相較之下，台股在AI產業獲利與外資回流帶動下相對抗跌、指數維持高檔。市場須留意殖利率與油價若續升，恐壓抑全球評價面與資金風險偏好，牽動台股後市與類股輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese market commentary notes US equities, after repeated record highs for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, now face twin pressures from long-dated Treasury yields spiking and oil climbing back above US$100. The 10-year yield briefly reached about 5.36% and the 30-year topped 5.7%, while Taiwan's index held up on AI-driven earnings and foreign inflows.

items.title_zh: 台媒：美股收黑、油價續飆 台積電ADR走弱
items.title_en: Taiwan media: US stocks slip as oil keeps surging and TSMC ADR falls
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，近一交易日美股道瓊收黑，主因油價續漲，台積電美國存託憑證（ADR）下跌逾1%。報導指出，原油走高與利率疑慮壓抑市場風險胃納。由於台積電權重高，美股與其ADR的表現往往牽動台股隔日開盤與電子權值股走勢，投資人多以此作為盤前風向參考，須留意國際油價與美債殖利率變化對台股的連動影響。
items.summary_en: Local coverage of a recent Wall Street session reported the Dow closing lower as oil prices extended gains, with TSMC's US-listed ADRs dropping more than 1%. The report highlighted how rising crude and rate concerns weighed on risk appetite, a read-through that often pressures Taiwan's tech-heavy index at the next open given TSMC's large weighting.

items.title_zh: 美股小幅收低 晶片股走弱抵銷銀行財報（2026-10-13）
items.title_en: US stocks end little changed as chip weakness offsets bank earnings (2026-10-13)
items.summary_zh: 美股週二小幅收黑，記憶體晶片股下跌抵銷Q3銀行財報開跑的激勵。標普500跌0.02%至7,805.45點，那斯達克綜合指數跌0.15%至27,204.38點，道瓊跌0.35%（約180點）至51,670.10點。投資人在週三9月CPI公布與更多大型銀行財報前轉趨觀望，市場在高檔震盪中等待通膨數據與Fed政策訊號指引方向。
items.summary_en: Wall Street closed near flat on Tuesday as declines in memory-chip names offset the start of Q3 bank earnings. The S&P 500 slipped 0.02% to 7,805.45, the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.15% to 27,204.38, and the Dow dropped 0.35% (about 180 points) to 51,670.10. Investors turned cautious ahead of Wednesday's September CPI release and more big-bank results.

items.title_zh: 高盛交易爆發財報超預期 摩根大通營收不如預期（2026-10-13）
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs beats as trading surges while JPMorgan misses on revenue (2026-10-13)
items.summary_zh: 美國大型銀行週二揭開第三季財報。高盛每股稀釋盈餘17.01美元、營收186.8億美元、年增23%，受股票交易營收大增72%帶動，股價走高；摩根大通則因證券投資損失，營收與調整後每股盈餘不如市場共識，股價走弱。花旗優於預期，富國銀行營收不如預期。財報分化凸顯交易業務強、傳統放款平淡，為美股財報季定調，市場續觀察美銀與大摩等後續業績。
items.summary_en: Big US banks opened Q3 earnings on Tuesday. Goldman Sachs posted diluted EPS of $17.01 on revenue of $18.68bn, up 23% year-on-year, powered by a 72% jump in equities-trading revenue; its shares rose. JPMorgan missed, with revenue and adjusted EPS below consensus after securities losses, and its shares slipped. Citigroup beat estimates while Wells Fargo missed on revenue.

items.title_zh: 油價高檔 布蘭特站上105美元 荷姆茲供給疑慮升溫（2026-10-13）
items.title_en: Oil holds elevated with Brent above $105 on Hormuz supply jitters (2026-10-13)
items.summary_zh: 原油週二維持高檔，西德州中級原油（WTI）約每桶92美元，布蘭特原油約105至106美元，因荷姆茲海峽油輪通行減少使供給疑慮升溫。分析機構預期，在美伊談判分歧下，布蘭特原油可能數月維持在100美元之上，使能源成為通膨與總經的重要變數。油價居高在美國CPI公布前，加深市場對通膨與Fed政策的敏感度，牽動債市與股市表現。
items.summary_en: Crude stayed high on Tuesday, with WTI around $92 a barrel and Brent near $105–106, as reduced Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic kept supply concerns in focus. Forecasters expect Brent to hold above $100 for months amid a wide US–Iran gap, keeping energy a key inflation and macro swing factor ahead of the US CPI print.

items.title_zh: 美國今日公布9月關鍵通膨數據（2026-10-14）
items.title_en: US set to release key September inflation data today (2026-10-14)
items.summary_zh: 美國勞工統計局預定週三公布9月消費者物價指數，為Fed 9月升息後市場高度關注的指標。經濟學家普遍預期整體通膨將回升至約3.6~3.7%，能源為主要推升因素，核心通膨則維持在約2.4~2.5%。市場視此數據為Fed 10月底決策的關鍵依據，數據結果將牽動美債殖利率、美元與全球股市，並影響台股盤前氣氛與外資動向。
items.summary_en: The Bureau of Labor Statistics is due to publish the September consumer price index on Wednesday, a closely watched gauge after the Fed's September rate hike. Economists broadly expect headline inflation to tick up toward the mid-3% range, with energy a key driver, while core stays near 2.4–2.5%. The reading is seen as pivotal for the Fed's late-October decision.
